character.name: Idle
character.prompt:
A young Korean male survivor in his mid-20s, facing directly forward,
full-body neutral standing pose, arms relaxed at his sides.

Short black hair with a slightly side-swept fringe.
Stylized adult proportions, moderately small head, lean build.
Wearing an open ochre-brown canvas work jacket with sleeves rolled
up to the elbows, bare forearms, a cream T-shirt,
slate-blue trousers and brown work boots.

Clean low-resolution pixel art designed for a 32x32 game sprite.
Simple readable shapes, bold connected pixel clusters,
crisp dark outlines, limited muted colors,
two-tone shading, minimal clothing details.
Clearly separated arms and legs.
Preserve a grounded but slightly stylized indie-game appearance.

One character only, centered, transparent background.
No weapon, no bag, no mutation, no accessories.
